examples.text: Mr. <w>Rowe</w> gave an interesting lecture on medieval history yesterday.

examples.text: I spoke with Professor <w>Rowe</w> about the upcoming assignment.

senses.sense_definition: A town in Franklin County, Massachusetts, United States.

examples.text: They moved to <w>Rowe</w> to enjoy quiet rural life in western Massachusetts.

target_lang_translations.ru: Они переехали в <w>Роу</w>, чтобы наслаждаться тихой сельской жизнью на западе Массачусетса.

examples.text: The small town of <w>Rowe</w> is known for its scenic autumn landscapes.

target_lang_translations.ru: Маленький городок <w>Роу</w> известен своими живописными осенними пейзажами.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Город в округе Франклин, штат Массачусетс, США.

senses.sense_definition: A census-designated place in San Miguel County, New Mexico, United States.

examples.text: We drove through <w>Rowe</w> on our road trip across New Mexico.

target_lang_translations.ru: Мы проехали через <w>Роу</w> во время нашего путешествия на машине по Нью-Мексико.

examples.text: The community of <w>Rowe</w> is located along historic railway routes.
